title: Error summary
overview: After submit: a focused list of errors that link to each field, plus per-field messages.
apply_when: The form failed validation and they need both a map and the field fix.
not_when: A standing page alert, a toast, or native required bubbles as the only UI.

vs.why: in-page status, not a field-linked summary

role.overview: A page-level list of errors that jump to the fields. Fields still show their own errors.
role.apply_when: After submit when one or more fields failed.
role.not_when: A toast, or field errors with no summary when the house requires both.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Each error is a link to the field.
composition.not_when: A paragraph of errors with no jumps.

state.overview: Visible at the top of the form after validate.
state.not_when: Shown on first paint before they tried.

accessibility.overview: The summary has a heading AT can speak.
accessibility.not_when: A red box with no heading.

accessibility.overview: Focus moves to the summary when it appears after submit.
accessibility.not_when: They are left at the submit button with no announcement.

accessibility.overview: Each item moves focus to the field.
accessibility.apply_when: More than one error, or one error that is off-screen.

keyboard.overview: Tab from the summary into the list of jumps, then to the form.
keyboard.not_when: The summary is not focusable and never announced.

keyboard.overview: Enter on an error link jumps to the field.
